content:
incident-bot: Pager — elevated 502/504 rate observed from api-gateway-edge (region: us-west-2). alert level: P1. currently 12m window, error rate 18%

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. I'm on it. pulling dashboards and recent deploys.

alice.k: I'm available to help with routing changes / can flip fallbacks if needed.

oncall-sre: Quick check — any recent infra deploys in the last 30m?

emily.p: No application deploys from product in last 60m. CI shows no churn.

oncall-sre: Running quick synthetic against edge: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/ping` -> returning `502 0.38` repeatedly.

luis.p: Checking ingress LB health and backends now. 

netops-bot: LB: healthchecks failing on subset of backends (asg-ml-*) — tcp reset count rising.

oncall-sre: Can someone grep load balancer logs for connection resets + backend 502s? `kubectl logs -n gateway ingress-proxy-0 --since=15m | grep "502"`

alice.k: Logs showing `upstream sent invalid response` from model-proxy pods; also seeing `connection reset by peer` in same timeframe.

emily.p: Customer-impact check: error rate by route — /v1/generate 22% errors, /v1/embed 3% errors. Most impact on long-polling generation endpoints.

oncall-sre: Hypothesis: backend model pool is overloading and dropping connections under higher concurrency, causing ingress to return 502s. Two mitigations to try in parallel: 1) enable short-circuit fallback to lightweight-model variant for requests > 4s; 2) reduce per-connection concurrency on ingress to avoid backend overload.

luis.p: I'm rolling a temporary config to reduce max_backend_conns from 100 -> 40 on the edge-proxy group. Patching now.

oncall-sre: Alice can you enable the routing rule to prefer model-small for any request with seq_len > 1024? We'll need a quick rollout.

alice.k: Applying weighted-route: `route.add_rule(path_prefix: "/v1/generate", header: "X-Seq-Len", condition: ">1024", weight: {small:0.7, default:0.3})` — rollout step 1 -> 10%

emily.p: Noting internal ticket to product-support: 3 enterprise customers on dedicated capacity may see degraded throughput; notifying their CSMs.

oncall-sre: Observability: after the ingress patch error rate dropped from 18% -> 9% in 6m. After route rollout to 30% -> /v1/generate errors down to 6%. Latency for fallbacks increased a bit but successful.

incident-bot: Auto-note: Pager escalation triggered to network-eng after 15m of elevated errors.

raj.m: I'm taking over as secondary oncall to coordinate region failover if this persists. Any indication of region-wide egress saturation?

luis.p: Checked egress metrics — NAT connection saturations peaked ~15m ago, currently trending down after ASG scale-up. No obvious cross-region issues.

oncall-sre: Plan: keep route fallback at 40% for 20m, keep backend_conns at 40, and prepare canary traffic to us-east-1 in case we need region fallback. Also create a short-lived circuit-breaker rule to fail fast on connections that exceed 6s.

alice.k: Circuit-breaker rule ready: `cb.add_policy(service: "model-proxy", threshold: {concurrent:50, latency_ms:6000}, action: fail_fast)` — staging check passed. Ready to apply to us-west-2 edge group.

emily.p: Customer impact update: 14/120 customers experienced >10% errors; 4 customers on dedicated infra reported timeouts. Raising CS priority for those.

oncall-sre: Applying circuit-breaker now to edge group.

netops-bot: circuit-breaker applied to ingress-proxy group.

oncall-sre: After CB + routing fallback + reduced backend_conns: error rate steady ~3-5% for last 8m. No new alerts on health checks.

raj.m: Good stabilization. I'm going to draft a short incident summary and escalate to postmortem if errors reappear. Can the SREs collect core dumps / stack traces from model-proxy for pods that reset?

luis.p: Capturing core dumps now for pods with recent resets — uploading to /internal/incident/3777002468/artifacts.

alice.k: I'll leave the fallback route at 40% for another 30m then ramp down to normal if stable.

oncall-sre: Handing off active pager to raj.m for the 2hr follow-up window. If errors exceed 8% again, re-pager the full SRE rota.

raj.m: Ack takeover. I'll keep the runbook open: runbook/gateway-502s. Notifying on-call for netops for 30m watch.

emily.p: I'll update impacted customers and provide ETA: monitoring continues, mitigation in place.

oncall-sre: Closing immediate hotfix steps in chat. Follow-ups: investigate root cause (connection reset source), evaluate model-proxy resource limits, and consider autoscaling tuning for model pools.

incident-bot: Incident note: P1 mitigated (reduction to <5% errors). Please file follow-up tickets and add timeline.

raj.m: Handing final: I have control for follow-up. If nobody objects, I'll create the postmortem ticket and assign owners for infra (luis.p), runtime (alice.k), and customer comms (emily.p).

emily.p: Fine with that. I'll author customer-facing summary after the postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:
